title: Three contradictory CI gate counts: script header 13, --mac line 10, PR body 11/11
evidence:
+#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 13 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
 #   tools/ci-local.sh --mac           # the same 10 gates natively on macOS
+- `tools/ci-local.sh` — **11/11 gates green** (incl. the golden harness, PP_DEBUG overlay builds, input parity, the W1 drift negative test).
+# Gates 12-13 are LOCAL-ONLY extra legs (no ci.yml steps): the font-guard
detail: Baseline said 10 gates; this diff adds exactly two GATES entries (12 total). The header now claims 13, the untouched --mac line still says 10, and the PR body says 11/11 — three mutually inconsistent counts.
recommended_fix: Recount the GATES array; make the header, the --mac line, and the PR body agree on one number.

title: overlay_pixels_check skips the flip/swizzle normalization every other readback in this diff applies
evidence:
+	img := rl.LoadImageFromScreen()
+	defer rl.UnloadImage(img)
+	px := rl.LoadImageColors(img)
vs gallery.odin:
+// gallery_shot — read the rlsw memory framebuffer (the harness pattern:
+// bottom-up + BGRA — flip + swizzle before export; the same normalization
+	img := rl.LoadImageFromScreen()
+	rl.ImageFlipVertical(&img)
and font_check.odin:
+	img := rl.LoadImageFromScreen()
+	rl.ImageFlipVertical(&img)
+	swizzle_rb(&img)
detail: Gate 12 runs this verb on the rlsw shadow the diff itself documents as bottom-up; the un-flipped y-indexing samples a vertically mirrored region, not the NOC panel rect.
recommended_fix: Apply the same flip (and swizzle) before LoadImageColors, or extract one normalized readback helper all captures share.

title: font_merge_fallback leaks the fallback glyph array when the merged MemAlloc fails
evidence:
+	fg := rl.LoadFontData(raw_data(fdata), c.int(len(fdata)), size,
+	merged := cast([^]rl.GlyphInfo)rl.MemAlloc(c.uint(size_of(rl.GlyphInfo) * int(total)))
+	if merged == nil {
+		return glyphs, count
+	}
...
+	rl.MemFree(fg)     // N3: the fallback ARRAY block too
detail: On the merged==nil early return, the fallback glyph array fg allocated above is never MemFree'd; every other exit path frees it.
recommended_fix: Free fg (or defer its free) before the merged==nil early return.

title: Health chip text grows to 15px while the row step stays 15px — zero leading
evidence:

+		draw_text_c(v, chip, chip_x, chip_y, hud(v, 15), chip_col)
 		chip_y += hud(v, 15)
detail: Chip rows now have zero leading; the same diff deliberately cites 16px NOC rows to fit 15px text, but the health chips got no such clearance.
recommended_fix: Raise the chip_y step to hud(v, 16) or verify no glyph collision at 15/15.

title: FONT_GLYPH_PADDING=4 documented as 'raylib's LoadFontEx default'; raylib's loader packs with padding 2
evidence:
+FONT_GLYPH_PADDING :: 4 // the atlas packing padding (raylib's LoadFontEx default)
+	// raylib LoadFontEx pattern: GenImageFontAtlas with PIXELPACK(0) + the 4px
+	// padding)
detail: raylib's LoadFontFromMemory calls GenImageFontAtlas with padding 2; the 'same recipe' claim misstates the default. Functionally harmless (self-consistent packing), but the parity rationale is wrong.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment, or use padding 2 if atlas parity with LoadFontEx actually matters.
